site_name: Land At Legacy Wharf (Phase 3), Barbers Road, Pudding Mill, London, E15 2PW
description: Hybrid planning application for comprehensive regeneration comprising: Application for outline permission (all matters reserved) for the demolition of existing buildings and erection of 6-buildings ranging between six (6) to fourteen (14) storeys in height to provide: residential units, including affordable housing (Use Class C3), and flexible commercial floorspace (Use Class E), together with associated blue badge car and cycle parking, public open spaces, landscaping and infrastructure works; and application for full planning permission for the erection of one building, extending between eight (8) and nine (9) storeys in height, to provide affordable units (Use Class C3) and flexible commercial floorspace (Use Class E), together with associated car and cycle parking, public open space, landscaping, public realm improvements and infrastructure works.
